scripts.build-strict: npm run generate-spec && npm run build-only -- --lint-spec --strict
scripts.build: npm run generate-spec && npm run build-only -- --lint-spec
scripts.build-local: npm run local-dev-spec && npm run build-only -- --lint-spec
scripts.prebuild-only: npm run clean && mkdir out && cp -R img out
scripts.build-for-pdf: npm run generate-spec && npm run prebuild-only && ecmarkup --verbose spec.html --printable --assets external --no-minify out/index.html
scripts.pdf: npm run build-for-pdf && prince-books --script ./node_modules/ecmarkup/js/print.js out/index.html -o out/ECMA-TEA.pdf
scripts.local-dev-pdf: npm run local-dev-spec && npm run prebuild-only && ecmarkup --verbose spec.html --printable --assets external --no-minify out/index.html && prince-books --script ./node_modules/ecmarkup/js/print.js out/index.html -o out/ECMA-TEA.pdf
